shortDescription: Get repository-script objects facts on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts the results by search criteria. Automatically sorts the results by Name, in the ascending order. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.
